frameworks.change: Drop net8.0 and net472; no conditional code.

notes: Today this package is HTML -> Markdown only; Markdown -> HTML is rendered by OfficeIMO.Markdown itself (MarkdownDoc.ToHtml*, HtmlOptions). The package name implies both directions.
No OfficeIMO.Core ProjectReference; it arrives transitively through OfficeIMO.Html and OfficeIMO.Markdown.
openQuestions: Static From{Source} on a type owned by another package (WordDocument.FromHtml in OfficeIMO.Word.Html, WordDocument.FromMarkdown, MarkdownDocument.FromHtml, WordDocument.FromPdf) is only possible with C# 14 static extension members. The SDK supports them for netstandard2.0 targets, but callers on older language versions (.NET Framework projects default to C# 7.3, Windows PowerShell) must call the containing static class directly. Alternative: keep instance forms on the source (pdf.ToWord(), html.ToWordDocument()) as the only adapter shape.
The package is one-directional (HTML -> Markdown); Markdown -> HTML lives in OfficeIMO.Markdown.
